newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwandan President denies supporting Zairean rebels.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan President denies supporting Zairean rebels.

text.p: Rwandan President Pasteur Bizimungu on Monday denied providing military help to Banyamulenge Tutsi rebels in eastern Zaire but said he morally supported their struggle against "extermination" by Zairean authorites.
Bizimungu also denied Rwanda's Tutsi-dominated army had been involved in the shelling of Rwandan Hutu refugee camps in east Zaire.

"We are not supporting the Banyamulenge military we are not interested in the conquest of land, but people's rights must be respected.The Banyamulenge are entitled to live in Zaire," the President told a news conference at his Kigali office.
"Morally I support their struggle between extermination and survival, I support their resistance against the Zairean authories."
Denying charges his forces shelled the camps he said:"We do not have the weaponry to shell the camps from our positions."
